summary: A dispatched worker has no general Concord state-query or mutation access. Its packet remains complete declared context. Explicit capabilities may expose bounded pages of original pinned readings and selection of recorded executable checks, not new context discovery or workflow authority. Source reads reuse committed proof and revalidate the active attempt and source identities. Native-oracle receipt authority stays with the host producer. Utilities retain complete Concord-tool denial, and missing context or executable backing uses the report boundary.
title: Worker lanes use declared context and bounded host capabilities
